description: Returns the page where the user reviews the trial and the price of the list and pays with iDEAL. This tool moves no money: payment only happens when the user pays on that page. Optionally stores the user's own e-mail address for delivery of the file and the invoice.

email.description: Optional. The user's own e-mail address for delivery of the file and the invoice, only if the user typed it.

name: create_list_payment_link
